The hypothesis (based on the proof_context used for checking) involves substituting definitions like \(A = \tfrac{1}{2} + h\) and \(\lambda_n = 2nh\) into an exponent to arrive at a combined exponent of \(-1 + 2h(n-1)\). The only algebraic claim that was transcribed and verified was this specific simplification: \(-2A + \lambda_n\) with those definitions indeed simplifies to \(-1 + 2h(n-1)\). The identity_checks tool found that step to be internally consistent — the left‑hand side and right‑hand side match when the definitions are plugged in.
